patterns.note: Full-width content sections are defined by distinct, highly saturated background colors that create strong visual breaks and delineate different thematic areas.
A horizontal scrolling image gallery is integrated directly below the main hero content, allowing users to browse visual content without leaving the hero section.
Headings use a large, bold sans-serif typeface for immediate impact, contrasting with smaller, lighter-weight body text, maintaining clear hierarchy.
The site uses a vibrant, almost primary color palette (blue, yellow, green) for large background blocks, creating a playful yet bold brand identity.
The main navigation bar (logo and 'Tenez-moi informé') remains sticky at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, maintaining constant access.
As the user scrolls, new content sections with contrasting background colors smoothly replace the previous section, creating a clear visual transition between different parts of the page.

technique_notes: To rebuild the section transitions, each major content block should be a full-width element with a solid, distinct background color. As the user scrolls, these sections simply move up the viewport, covering the previous content, with the sticky header remaining fixed above them.
The navigation bar should be implemented as a fixed element at the top of the viewport, ensuring it stays visible regardless of scroll position.
The horizontal image gallery can be built using a flexbox or grid layout with `overflow-x: scroll` to enable side-to-side browsing of image cards within a confined area.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold headings (~3-4x body text) create strong visual anchors, complemented by clear, legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle, used for interactive elements like search inputs and image cards, providing a soft edge without being fully rounded.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and comfortable padding within content blocks, creating an airy feel.

standout: The most distinctive aspect is the bold and almost primary color blocking for entire sections, which creates a highly energetic and memorable visual identity. This strong use of color, combined with clean typography and simple line illustrations, makes the site feel playful yet sophisticated, departing from more muted or gradient-heavy modern designs.
